editorial:
You meet Eddie, a forty-year-old guy who has spent his whole life dodging commitment. When he finally ties the knot with the gorgeous Lila, you think he has finally figured things out. But the honeymoon in Mexico quickly turns into a disaster, and you watch him fall for another woman while still on his honeymoon. It is a wild, awkward ride that mixes big laughs with cringe-worthy moments, and you never quite know what Eddie will do next.

Ben Stiller carries the movie with his usual nervous energy, and the Farrelly brothers keep the jokes coming fast. The scenery in Mexico looks great, and there are some genuinely funny scenes that will make you laugh out loud. On the downside, the humor can feel mean-spirited at times, and some jokes push too far. If you enjoy edgy romantic comedies and do not mind uncomfortable situations, you will have a good time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Eddie leaves Lila and marries Miranda, the woman he met in Mexico. But during their honeymoon, Miranda starts showing annoying habits, like snoring loudly and being messy. Eddie realizes he has made the same mistake again and is trapped in another bad marriage. The movie ends with him looking defeated, suggesting the grass is not always greener and that he never learns his lesson.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves edgy romantic comedies and Ben Stiller movies.
